title: The Mandate
body_markdown: King James I commissioned the translation in 1604, aiming for a version that was accurate and accessible.

title: The Translators
body_markdown: Six committees comprising 47 of the greatest scholars of the day worked diligently on the translation.

title: The 1611 Printing
body_markdown: The first edition was printed by Robert Barker in 1611, featuring unique orthography and marginal notes.

title: The Apocrypha
body_markdown: The original 1611 KJV included the Apocrypha between the Testaments, as part of the historical corpus.

title: Standardization
body_markdown: Over the centuries, spellings were modernized, leading to the versions commonly used today, while the 1611 remains the foundation.
